subject: Converge on serving lane & geography for POC — MAP action items
messages:
From: Lina Moreno <lina.moreno@healthtech.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carol Sato <carol@healthtech.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + outstanding gating questions

Thanks Priya — the MAP looks good. We have two items that will determine our deployment lane: (1) proof of encrypted at-rest key handling (our compliance team requires HSM/KMS mapping) and (2) region residency for PHI processing. 

Quick asks from our side: can Redwood run the POC in a dedicated pool in us-west-2, or will hosted with customer-managed KMS satisfy the reviewers? Also, can you provide a compact cost/latency comparison for hosted vs dedicated for our typical throughput (50 QPS sustained, peaks to 200 QPS)?

If we can lock that down this week, procurement will sign the MAP and we can target a Dec 15 pilot start.

— Lina
Lina Moreno
Head of Data Platforms | HealthTech

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Moreno <lina.moreno@healthtech.ai>, Carol Sato <carol@healthtech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + outstanding gating questions

Lina — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front:
- KMS/HSM: Yes, we can demonstrate customer-managed KMS for hosted; Private (VPC) or Dedicated supports HSM integrations if you need on-prem keys.
- Region residency: we can run the POC in a dedicated pool in us-west-2. Hosted in us-west-2 with strict routing + dedicated tenancy is also viable.

Attaching a compact comparison and the latest MAP (v3). See the attachment "HealthTech_MAP_v3.pdf" for the proposed timeline and acceptance criteria. The cost model is attached as an XLSX with assumptions.

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood to confirm technical KMS integration steps & SOC evidence (by EOD Mon).
2) HealthTech to confirm whether procurement needs an SLA addendum for dedicated pools (target Tue).
3) We lock hosting lane (Hosted-with-customer-KMS vs Dedicated) by Wed so infra can schedule the us-west-2 pool.

I’ll also loop our infra lead for the capacity sketch.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: HealthTech_MAP_v3.pdf; redwood-dedicated-cost-model.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Moreno <lina.moreno@healthtech.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + outstanding gating questions

Priya — quick capacity note: we have a slot for a small dedicated pool in us-west-2 that can be reserved for HealthTech the week of Dec 13. Lead time for a larger committed capacity would push into Jan. If HealthTech is flexible on initial pool size for the POC (targeted throughput 50–200 QPS with autoscale burst), we can provision a dedicated lane for the pilot.

Also adding: if they choose hosted + customer KMS, ops will need the KMS ARN and we’ll run a short integration test (2–3 hours) to validate key access patterns. 

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lina Moreno <lina.moreno@healthtech.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + outstanding gating questions

Team — two governance points to resolve before we firm the MAP:
1) Legal needs to confirm whether the MAP requires an SLA appendix for Dedicated lane (if HealthTech requests explicit dedicated tenancy). Priya, can you pull in legal and ask for a 24-hour review?
2) Security wants the SOC snapshot (I see a SOC2 PDF referenced). Please attach the exact evidence bundle we’ll send to HealthTech.

If both are green by Tue EOD we'll commit to the us-west-2 slot and I’ll approve the pilot credits.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Moreno <lina.moreno@healthtech.ai>, Carol Sato <carol@healthtech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Finalized MAP commitments & next steps (POC lane + region)

Hi Lina / Carol — quick update and consolidated asks so we can close the MAP this week: 

Summary of commitments (Redwood):
- POC lane: Dedicated pool reserved in us-west-2 for pilot week of Dec 13 (small pool to support 50 QPS sustained, bursts to 200 QPS).
- KMS: We will run hosted KMS integration as a fallback; for Dedicated we’ll validate HSM mapping with Security. Evidence bundle (SOC2 snapshot) attached.
- Cost/latency: See attached "redwood-dedicated-cost-model.xlsx" for the summary; appendix in MAP_v3 highlights expected p95 token latency at your profile.

Open items for HealthTech (please reply in-line):
1) Confirm procurement needs an SLA appendix for Dedicated tenancy (Procurement contact and timeline).
2) Provide KMS ARN or confirm you want Redwood to run hosted KMS config for the POC.
3) Confirm acceptance criteria for pilot success (latency, throughput, quality eval pass rate).

If we get answers to the three items by EOD Thu (Dec 2), Redwood will trigger legal and infra provisioning and ship the evidence package. That puts us on track for the Dec 13 pilot start. 

Thanks all — looping Aditya for the final infrastructure checklist.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: HealthTech_MAP_v3.pdf; SOC2_evidence_snapshot_2026-11-20.pdf; redwood-dedicated-cost-model.xlsx
